title: Layout of a decoded tableau row
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $w$ be the number of possible snapshots of $M$. Suppose a Boolean list $\mathrm{pre}$ has length $w$, and a Boolean list $F$ has length $k(w+1)$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$. For any bits $a,b,c,d$, the list $\mathrm{pre} ++ [a,b,c] ++ F ++ [d]$ has prefix of length $w$ equal to $\mathrm{pre}$; its entries at indices $w,w+1,w+2$ are respectively $a,b,c$; dropping its first $w+3$ entries yields $F ++ [d]$; and its entry at index $w+3+k(w+1)$ is $d$.
